# Contributing to Termco

Thank you for helping improve Termco.

## Before opening work

- Search existing [issues](https://github.com/termco-ai/termco/issues) and [discussions](https://github.com/termco-ai/termco/discussions).
- Use Discussions for feature and plugin ideas. An accepted idea becomes a scoped issue before implementation starts.
- Use the issue forms for reproducible application, plugin, documentation, and accessibility problems.
- Discuss substantial changes before opening a large pull request.

## Development

Follow the setup and validation commands in the repository README. Keep changes focused, add or update tests where behavior changes, and avoid unrelated formatting or generated-file changes.

## Pull requests

- Link the issue the pull request addresses.
- Explain the user-visible result and how it was verified.
- Keep application and plugin release changes separated when they have independent release paths.
- Do not commit credentials, signing keys, user data, or private logs.

By participating, you agree to keep technical discussion respectful, specific, and constructive.
